articles.title: Lydia Rooney, 74, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Lydia Rooney for the many years of service to Foxglove Heights.
body: Lydia Rooney died in January at home on Foxglove Court, at the age of 74. Born in Foxglove Heights in the years after the war, Lydia Rooney spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.

Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Foxglove Heights. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Millrace Library branch in his or her name.
